It was Halloween and I was out with my brothers trick or treating. It was a clear night, relatively dark, no significant wind movement, the stars were out, and just chilly enough to be October. Perfect night to collect candy.

We were walking along the sidewalk when I noticed I something odd somewhere above me: I couldn't see the stars anymore. Normally when you walk under a street light, your vision almost goes blind to all but the brightest ones when adjusting to the brightness, but this was different. When I looked up it was pitch black. Featureless. Nothing. I scanned down and saw that I could see the stars on the horizon, but at a certain point they just were blocked out.

That's when all of us saw it move. It was big. About 200 feet across- ish (I was 9 at the time), It was triangular, it was completely featureless, and it was hovering about 10 feet above the houses around us.

When my brothers noticed what I was looking at, we tried walking away, thinking it was some kind of blanket caught in the breeze out something. Then it followed us, centered right above us. They started running and I slowed down enamored by the next thing I noticed: it was dead silent. No real air movement. No humming of some machine, no blades, no jets, no strings pulling it along, but it moved following us up the block. I walked out towards the middle of the street to see if it would follow me sideways, and it did.

I distinctly remember my brothers standing on the corner of an intersection yelling back at me to run, but all I could do was look up at this thing stopped dead straight above me and think "what do you want?".

It was uncanny how many of my senses couldn't pick up anything on this thing. There were no reflections, no noises, no smells, no wind, it was too high to touch. Even gauging a general size of the thing was hard. It passed over the street lights, but realistically it could have been 30 feet up and 200 across, it could have been 1000 up and a mile across, our it could have been a few miles up and the size of a state. All I know it that it had the general profile of a rounded off triangle when viewed from the bottom. There was nothing else I had on it. It was just a hole in my view of the stars.

Years later I came across a video on Vantablack and just got chills up my spine remembering this thing.
